comments.text:
In Douala, nearly 12 feet of rain falls in an average year, yet fewer than half of its homes can count on a reliable tap close by. ☔🚰
If you lived in Cameroon for a week, which would you miss first: the city bus, the tap at home, or small change in your pocket?
